title: HIV Reservoir Quantification by Five-Target Multiplex Droplet Digital PCR
author: Levy, Hughes, et al.
materials: In order to be able to quantify data about multi-positive populations, .qlp files exported from the Bio-Rad QX200 software must be analyzed in Bio-Rad’s Quanta-Soft Analysis Pro software, which is available for free download (with registration) from https://www.bio-rad.com/en-us/product/qx200-droplet-digital-pcr-system?ID=MPOQQE4VY
See also: Bio-Rad’s Droplet Digital TM PCR Applications Guide for mathematical details. Page 35 derives the equation for calculating concentration from droplet counts and volume.

steps.title: Prepare lysis reagents in sample tube
steps.instruction: For cell samples, add 20 µL Guanidine HCl (GuHCl) and 20 µL of 20 mg/mL proteinase K; for tissue samples, add 180 µL buffer ATL and 20 µL of 20 mg/mL proteinase K.

steps.title: Add guanidine isothiocyanate
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL of 6 M guanidine isothiocyanate to the tube.

substeps.instruction: For cell samples, pipette up and down with wide‑bore filter tips.
For tissue samples, invert the tube several times (pipette tips may clog).

steps.title: Add cold isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 100 % molecular‑grade isopropanol kept at approximately 25 °C (cold temperatures cause contaminating salts to precipitate).

steps.title: Mix by inversion
steps.instruction: Invert the tube 10 times to mix.

steps.title: Centrifuge to pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed (≈21,000 × g) for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Pipet off most of the supernatant, leaving ~100 µL behind; dispose of the removed supernatant as guanidine waste (do not mix with bleach or pour down the drain).

steps.title: Wash pellet with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 70 % ethanol, then invert the tube 10 times to mix.

steps.title: Brief centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed for 1 minute.

steps.title: Remove ethanol completely
steps.instruction: Pipette off all supernatant, spin briefly in a micro‑benchtop centrifuge, and remove any remaining liquid with a 20 µL pipette tip.

steps.title: Air‑dry pellet
steps.instruction: Open the tube lid and air‑dry for 5–10 minutes in a fume hood or biosafety cabinet until the pellet appears dry, crystalline, and odorless; continue drying if wet or ethanol odor persists.

steps.title: Resuspend in buffer EB
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL buffer EB and vortex for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Heat to dissolve DNA
steps.instruction: Incubate at 60 °C for 1 hour to fully dissolve the high‑molecular‑weight DNA; avoid pipetting, vortexing, or freezing at this stage.
